So only environments that do not set metrics_namespace to cortex are exposed. The proposed `any[image-in-use grafana/loki, ...]` is too broad: every Loki environment would match, including those that set cortex and are protected. correction.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 some metrics change prefix from cortex_ to loki_ because metrics_namespace defaults to loki. Environments that do not set metrics_namespace to cortex are exposed. Environments that set it to cortex keep the old names.
